checks.location: Population figure 1; hospital care figures 3 and 5
checks.verified: Population change 2005–2025: Alberta 51.4%, Canada 29.2%. Acute beds 2014–15 to 2023–24: count +4.2%, per resident −9.0%. Hospital government spending per resident, 2015 to 2025: Alberta $1,948 to $2,248; Canada $1,580 to $2,262. 2025 is a forecast.
checks.limitation: Do not derive rates from rounded population or bed counts. Government hospital spending is not all health spending. Retain published Canadian growth of 43.1% rather than 43.16% calculated from rounded dollar endpoints.

checks.verified: Alberta 2023/24 growth: students 3.6%, educators 3.0%, compensation 3.2%. Page 2 explicitly specifies constant 2023/24 dollars.
checks.limitation: Instructional and educational staff compensation is narrower than total funding. Educator count is not class size.

checks.verified: 2023–24 school-board spending per student: Alberta $13,607; comparable Canada $15,867. Comparison excludes NB, NL and territories; includes Alberta.
checks.limitation: This is not a comparison of provincial operating grants alone, or an adequacy threshold.

checks.location: PDF page 2, Provincial table; 2023–24 FQ4YTD and 2024–25 FQ4YTD columns
checks.verified: Emergency admitted-patient median length of stay at busiest sites: 12.8 to 13.3 hours. Scheduled hip replacements within CIHI benchmark: 62.4% to 70.1%.
checks.limitation: Separate outcomes with different scopes. These are full fiscal year-to-date values, not quarter-only values or the province-wide median across all emergency sites.

checks.location: National turnover-rent table and Calgary section
checks.verified: October 2024 to 2025 monthly two-bedroom purpose-built turnover rents: Calgary $1,927 to $1,836; Edmonton $1,560 to $1,600. Calgary 2025 rental supply growth 11%; vacancy rate 5.0%.
checks.limitation: CMA turnover rents are not all-tenant rents, a province-wide rent index or a quality-adjusted price index. City rental composition can change.

checks.verified: 2020/21–2024/25 weights: 20% previous, 30% current and 50% projected enrolment. From 2025/26: 30% current and 70% projected.
checks.limitation: The observed 2023/24 school measures predate this change. No policy outcome is estimated.

guardrails: Each metric retains its own reporting periods; no annual path is imputed.
No LLM-generated numbers, causal sliders or claims of policy attribution.
Missing observations remain null; percentage change from a zero baseline is null.
Curated snapshot; no automated freshness claim.
